description: The user's spaces. A space is a wallet: their personal one, or a shared one for a partner, roommates or a client. Use the NAME when a tool asks for a space. Always list existing spaces first and reuse one that fits before proposing a new space. Create only for money shared with other people (a household, trip or group), or an explicit request for a separate space. Personal money goes in Personal; never create a space per category, goal, account or month. Ask before creating: creation is a confirmed write, done in Bluu; offer its spaces link.
name: spaces
title: Your Spaces
